comment: Advisories accepted for `pnpm audit --prod` (scripts/audit-prod.ts, CI). Anything NOT listed fails the build. Each entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; after that date it fails again so it is re-reviewed.

allow.reason: Reached only through prisma > @prisma/config (the CLI that reads prisma7.config.ts at deploy time with trusted, repository-owned config). Not loaded by the API at runtime and no attacker-controlled input is merged.
Prisma peer chain (prisma > mysql2) for its MySQL tooling. The project uses PostgreSQL with @prisma/adapter-pg only; mysql2 is never imported or connected to.
Same unreachable prisma > mysql2 chain as above (PostgreSQL only).
